head: tad
target: rgyas par bya na gal te de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshe'i tshad bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du gnas pas bstan kyang skyes bu dam pa de dag gi yon tan gyi mtha' bstan par mi nus la/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi yon tan rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i shes rab kyi spobs pa bla na med pa de gnyis ka yang bsam gyis mi khyab cing mtshungs pa med pa'i phyir ro/ / bcom ldan 'das kha cig pad ma'i mngal na gnas pa dang / kha cig pad ma la skyil mo krung bcas nas brdzus te 'byung ba de'i rgyu ni gang lags/
src_sentence: tatko 'tra bhagavan hetuḥ kaḥ pratyayo yadanye garbhāvāsaṃ prativasanti,
